title: Letter and Verdict Again
author: Cyrus Quintana
blurb: Quentin Eastwick, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the trial begins.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
